53701.meaning1: of such habit; of whatever behaviour
53701.commentary: (VINa) yathāsīlo'ti sīlesu yathāsīlo vā tathāsīlo vā hotu, navakammasīlo vā uddesasīlo vā vāsadhurasīlo vā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.

53702.meaning1: as one likes; as is comfortable; according to one's pleasure

examples.text: sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.
idaṃ pure cittam'acāri cārikaṃ, yen'icchakaṃ yatthakāmaṃ yathāsukhaṃ, tadajj'ahaṃ niggahessāmi yoniso, hatthippabhinnaṃ viya aṅkusaggaho.

53703.commentary: (DNa) yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattan'ti yathā mayā suto c'eva uggahito ca, evaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti.
no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkeyyāsi anuvicāreyyāsi manasā anupekkheyyāsi

53704.meaning1: like when he; as when one

examples.text: tathā tathā, āvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yath'āssa vihāraṃ kappayato na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, na bhaddikā kālakiriyā.

53705.commentary: (DNa) yathāvajjaṃ nāma kāṇa-kuṇi-khujj'ādīnaṃ yaṃ yaṃ vajjaṃ, taṃ taṃ payojetvā dassanakīḷā. (DNt) vajja-saddo aparādh'attho'ti āha yathāvajjaṃ nāmā'ti-ādi. vādit'ānurūpaṃ naccanaṃ, gāyanaṃ vā yathāvajjan'ti'pi vadanti.

examples.text: akkharikāya'pi kīḷanti, man'esikāya'pi kīḷanti, yathāvajjena'pi kīḷanti. hatthismim'pi sikkhanti, assasmim'pi sikkhanti, rathasmim'pi sikkhanti, dhanusmim'pi sikkhanti, tharusmim'pi sikkhanti

53707.meaning1: teaching such a doctrine; holding such a view; of such an opinion
53707.commentary: (DNa) yathāvādī'ti yaṃ vācāya vadati, tadanvayam'ev'assa kāyakammaṃ hoti. yañ'ca kāyena karoti, tadanvayam'ev'assa vacīkammaṃ hoti. kāyo vā vācaṃ, vācā vā kāyaṃ n'ātikkamati, vācā kāyena, kāyo ca vācāya sameti.

examples.text: yathāvādī kho, āvuso, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya na kenaci loke viggayha tiṭṭhati

53708.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāvidita
53708.meaning1: according to one's knowledge; as experienced

examples.text: tassa so yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ byākaroti, evaṃ kho, āvuso, saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā, evaṃ saṅkhārā sammasitabbā, evaṃ saṅkhārā vipassitabbā'ti.

53710.meaning1: in what way it is liberated; how it is freed (from defilements)
53710.commentary: (ANa) yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ na paccavekkhatī'ti yathā yaṃ cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, ye ca dosā pahīnā, guṇā ca paṭiladdhā, te paccavekkhitvā upariguṇapaṭilābhāya vāyāmaṃ na karotī'ti attho.

examples.text: katame pañca? kamm'ārāmatā, bhass'ārāmatā, nidd'ārāmatā, saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ na paccavekkhati, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
na atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, na dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, na niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, na paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ na paccavekkhitā

53711.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāvihāra
53711.meaning1: wherever one lived; to each individual's residence

examples.text: atha kho therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ agamaṃsu. āyasmā'pi mahako sakaṃ vihāraṃ agamāsi.

53712.meaning1: of such lifestyle; whatever mode of living
53712.commentary: (VINa) yathāvihārī'ti vihāresu'pi yathāvihārī vā tathāvihārī vā hotu, navakammavihārī vā uddesavihārī vā vāsadhuravihārī vā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.

53714.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāvuḍḍha
53714.meaning1: according to seniority; according to age

examples.text: vuḍḍhānaṃ paṭipāṭi yathāvuḍḍhaṃ, ye ye vuḍḍhā vā yathāvuḍḍhaṃ, jīvassa yattako paricchedo yāvajīvaṃ, cittam'adhikicca pavattanti te dhammā'ti adhicittaṃ
tasmā akār'antā abyayībhāvasamāsā parāsaṃ vibhattīnaṃ kvaci aṃ hoti. adhicittaṃ, yathāvuḍḍhaṃ, upakumbhaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ, tiropabbataṃ, tiropākāraṃ, tirokuṭṭaṃ, antopāsādaṃ.
kilanto'smī'ti parissanto asmi. tena yathāvuttavedanānaṃ balavabhāvaṃ eva dasseti.

53716.meaning1: according to the previously mentioned manner
53716.commentary: (VISMa) yathāvuttappakāre'ti sace pana dasavassikenā'ti-ādinā (visuddhi. 1.299) yathāvutto pakāro etassā'ti yathāvuttappakāro, tasmiṃ.

examples.text: kathaṃ aparipakkato? so pan'āyam'āhāro evarūpe okāse nidhānam'upagato yāva aparipakko hoti, tāva tasmiññ'eva yathāvuttappakāre paramandhakāratimise nānākuṇapa-gandhavāsita-pavanavicarite atiduggandhajegucche padese

53717.commentary: (ITIa) gāthāsu yathāvuttaṃ mah'esinā'ti mah'esinā bhagavatā tiracchānagate dānaṃ datvā sataguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā' tiādinā, idh'eva vā evaṃ ce sattā jāneyyun'tiādinā yathāvuttaṃ, ñāṇacārena taṃ yathāvuttaṃ cittaṃ ñātan'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ ce sattā jāneyyuṃ, yathāvuttaṃ mah'esinā, vipākaṃ saṃvibhāgassa, yathā hoti mahapphalaṃ.
anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.
sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tathā bhāsatu yath'āhaṃ imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ jāneyyan'ti.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yath'eva mayā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito, evam'eva eta'r'ahi anuggaṇheyyaṃ bhikkhusaṅghan'ti.
so evaṃ vadeyya, asatī kir'āyaṃ, bho, vīṇā nāma, yath'evaṃ yaṃ kiñci vīṇā nāma ettha ca pan'āyaṃ jano ativelaṃ pamatto palaḷito'ti.

53722.meaning1: to whatever degree; so far as; as much as; in part

examples.text: yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.

53723.grammar: pron, nt acc sg of ya

examples.text: yadatthikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ acarī, kappāyano kacci'ssa taṃ amoghaṃ, nibbāyi so ādu saupādiseso, yathā vimutto ahu taṃ suṇoma.
ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.
vanaṃ yadaggi ḍahati, pāvako kaṇhavattanī, jāyanti tattha pārohā, ahorattānam'accaye.

53725.commentary: (DNa) yadagge'ti mūladivasato paṭṭhāya yaṃ divasaṃ aggaṃ parakoṭiṃ katvā viharāmī'ti attho, yāva vihāsin'ti vuttaṃ hoti. idāni tassa parimāṇaṃ dassento naciraṃ tīṇi vassānī'ti āha. atha vā yadagge'ti yaṃ divasaṃ aggaṃ katvā naciraṃ tīṇi vassāni viharāmī'ti'pi attho. yaṃ divasaṃ ādiṃ katvā naciraṃ vihāsiṃ tīṇi'y'eva vassānī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. ayaṃ kira bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ gaṇhanto tīṇi saṃvaccharāni bhagavantaṃ upaṭṭhāsi, taṃ sandhāya evaṃ vadati.

examples.text: yadagge ahaṃ, mahāli, bhagavantaṃ upanissāya viharāmi, na ciraṃ tīṇi vassāni, dibbāni hi kho rūpāni passāmi piyarūpāni kām'ūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no ca kho dibbāni saddāni suṇāmi piyarūpāni kām'ūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyānī'ti.

53726.commentary: (SNa) yadaññam'anusāsatī'ti yaṃ aññaṃ anusāsati, taṃ. sambuddho hit'ānukampī hitena anupakampati. yasmā ca hit'ānukampī, tasmā anurodhavirodhehi vippamutto tathāgato'ti.

examples.text: n'etaṃ tava patirūpaṃ, yadaññam'anusāsasi, anurodhavirodhesu, mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti.

53727.meaning1: whatever is past; what is gone
53727.commentary: (MNa) yadatītan'ti idam'ettha kāraṇavacanaṃ. yasmā yaṃ atītaṃ, taṃ pahīnaṃ niruddhaṃ atthaṅ'gataṃ, tasmā taṃ puna n'ānugaccheyya.

examples.text: atītaṃ n'ānvāgameyya, nappaṭikaṅkhe anāgataṃ, yadatītaṃ pahīnaṃ taṃ, appattañ'ca anāgataṃ.
te me ijjhiṃsu saṅkappā, yadattho pāvisiṃ kuṭiṃ, vijjāvimuttiṃ paccesaṃ, mān'ānusayam'ujjahan'ti.

53729.meaning1: whatever there is; whichever there are
53729.commentary: (MNa) yadatthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ pajahāmī'ti yaṃ atthi yaṃ bhūtaṃ eta'r'ahi khandhapañcakaṃ, taṃ pajahāmi.

examples.text: sahā'v'assa dassanasampadāya, tayassu dhammā jahitā bhavanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhi vicikicchitañ'ca, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi yadatthi kiñci.

evaṃ vutte, āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idha, bhante, bhikkhu evaṃ paṭipanno hoti, no c'assa, no ca me siyā, na bhavissati, na me bhavissati, yadatthi yaṃ, bhūtaṃ, taṃ pajahāmī'ti. evaṃ upekkhaṃ paṭilabhati.

53730.meaning1: what is non-self; whatever is not oneself

examples.text: yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā, yadanattā taṃ n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.

53731.meaningLit: discourse on whatever is not oneself

53732.meaning1: which is impermanent; what is unstable; what is unreliable

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ. yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tadatthaṅ'gatan'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

53734.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yadantara
53734.meaning1: during which time; for which interval

examples.text: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhāvesi maraṇassatin'ti? idha mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, aho vat'āhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ ekapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā'ti. evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhāvemi maraṇassatin'ti.

53735.meaning1: whatever itself; whatever even; which just

examples.text: yadapi, bhikkhave, alobho tadapi kusalamūlaṃ. yadapi aluddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi kusalaṃ.

53736.meaning1: directly knowing which; which knowing for oneself
53736.commentary: (DNa) yadabhijānaṃ tathāgato'ti yaṃ kilesanibbānaṃ jānanto tathāgato. (DNa) yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā'ti yaṃ tumhehi anabhiññātaṃ, taṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā abhijānanto bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro assa, adhikatarapañño bhaveyya. (DNa) yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā'ti yaṃ tumhehi anabhiññātaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā abhijānanto bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro assa, adhikatarapañño bhaveyya.

examples.text: aggaññañ'c'āhaṃ, bhaggava, pajānāmi. tañ'ca pajānāmi, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāmi, tañ'ca pajānaṃ na parāmasāmi, aparāmasato ca me paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā, yadabhijānaṃ tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati.

tatra idaṃ nissāya idaṃ pajahatha, tayo satipaṭṭhānā yadariyo sevati yadariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam'anusāsitum'arahati, so vuccati yogg'ācariyānaṃ anuttaro purisadammasārathī'ti, ayam'uddeso saḷāyatanavibhaṅgassa.
kudāssu nām'āhaṃ tadāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yadariyā eta'r'ahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantī'ti iti anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ.
sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
yadā kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭheyyuṃ, upanisīdeyyuṃ, upanipajjeyyuṃ.

53739.meaning1: whatever one likes; as one wishes
53739.meaning2: whatever one likes; whenever one likes
53739.commentary: (SNa) puccha yadākaṅkhasī'ti yaṃkiñci ākaṅkhasi, taṃ sabbaṃ puccha, asesaṃ te byākarissāmī'ti sabbaññupavāraṇaṃ pavāreti.

examples.text: desaṃ, sace me bhagavā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti? tena hi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sake āsane nisīditvā puccha yadākaṅkhasī'ti

53740.meaning1: when it is suitable; whenever it is fitting

examples.text: sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, anucchavikassa yad'ānulomikaṃ, taṃ vindati khippam'anomavikkamo ti.

53741.meaning1: even when; even at which time

examples.text: yadā'pi so upaṭṭhahati pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī, tadā'pi so vadhako'va, vadhakañ'ca pana santaṃ na aññāsi, vadhako me'ti.

53742.meaning1: which is made of iron; which is metal

examples.text: na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujaṃ pabbajañ'ca, sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.

yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ yā c'eva āyasmantānaṃ āpatti, yā ca attano āpatti, āyasmantānañc'eva atthāya, attano ca atthāya, saṅghamajjhe tiṇ'avatthārakena deseyyaṃ, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi, yadā'yaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmī'ti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, biḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre ṭhito ahosi mudumūsiṃ maggayamāno, yadā'yaṃ mudumūsi gocarāya pakkamissati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā khādissāmī'ti.
yadā'haṃ, bho, samaṇe gotame imaṃ paṭhamaṃ padaṃ addasaṃ ath'āhaṃ niṭṭham'agamaṃ, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.
gāme vā yadi vā-āraññe, ninne vā yadi vā thale, yattha arahanto viharanti, taṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ.
kathāsampayogena, bhikkhave, puggalo veditabbo yadi vā kaccho yadi vā akaccho'ti.
yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
puna caparaṃ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṃ yadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado'va upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.

idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena.

53749.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yadicchaka
53749.meaning1: as one wants; at will; at one's pleasure; (comm) whichever destination one wants to go to

examples.text: tam'enaṃ dakkho yogg'ācariyo assadammasārathi abhiruhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yen'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyā'pi paccāsāreyyā'pi

53750.meaning2: which is this, that is, namely

examples.text: ayaṃ me puggalo khamati imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. taṃ kissa hetu? abhikkantā h'esā, bho gotama, yadidaṃ upekkhā'ti.
udabindu yathā'pi pokkhare, padume vāri yathā na limpati, evaṃ muni n'opalimpati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā.

53752.meaning1: this thing; the previous person or statement

examples.text: yadetaṃ, mahārāja, tathāgato na bhaṇeyya, pattacīvaram'pi attano pariyādāpetvā bhikkhū buddhapūjaṃ y'eva kareyyun'ti. sādhu, bhante nāgasena, evam'etaṃ tathā sampaṭicchāmī'ti.
kacci'ttha, bhante, na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano'ti? na h'ettha, āvuso, koci gihī ahosi odātavasano'ti. sādhu, bhante, yadettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano'ti.
yadeva tvaṃ, rāhula, kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo ahosi, tadeva te kāyakammaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
añña'd'atthu, ayaṃ varāko idāni marissati, yaṃ yadeva hi ayaṃ padaṃ nikkhipati, tena tena santike maraṇassa hotī'ti taṃ jano karuṇāyati.

53757.meaning2: thrown or shot through a machine

examples.text: ye ca atimānapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, anatimānissa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabbo'ti, iti yan'taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
gabbham'eke uppajjanti, nirayaṃ pāpakammino, saggaṃ sugatino yanti, parinibbanti anāsavā.
taṃ nadīhi vijānātha, sobbhesu padaresu ca, saṇantā yanti kusobbhā, tuṇhīyanti mah'odadhī.

53766.meaning1: with whichever view; holding whichever opinion

53767.meaning1: what if I were to; let me; I shall; perhaps I
53767.meaning2: what if I, maybe I should, let me

examples.text: yan'nūn'āhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan'ti.

53768.meaning1: (gram) ya suffix; conjugational sign of group 3 divādigaṇa verbs

examples.text: divu'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato yapaccayo hoti kattari. dibbati, sibbati, yujjhati, vijjhati, bujjhati.

53769.meaning1: (gram) ya suffix; used to form passive verbs and impersonal verbs

examples.text: sabbehi dhātūhi bhāvakammesu yapaccayo hoti. ṭhīyate, bujjhate, paccate, labbhate, karīyate, yujjate, uccate. bhāvakammesū'ti kim'atthaṃ? karoti, pacati, paṭhati.
bhavati yadi gihī ciraṃ yapeti, cirataraṃ pabbajati yadi tato hi, yāpayati ca vas'iddhibhāvanāya, iti dīgh'āyukatāya taṃ nimittan'ti.

53771.meaning1: ruler of the underworld; king of death
53771.meaning2: ruler of the kingdom of the dead

examples.text: upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.
yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānaṃ, uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatassa jantu, atikkamma so vetaraṇiṃ yamassa, dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco'ti.
ajja kho, pan'ānanda, rattiyā pacchime yāme kusinārāyaṃ upavattane mallānaṃ sālavane antarena yamakasālānaṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati
sabbaphāliphullā kho, ānanda, yamakasālā akālapupphehi. te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
tena kho pana samayena yamakassa nāma bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti

53775.commentary: (ANa) yamako'ti-ādīni tesaṃ nāmāni. tesu hi eko yamako nāma, eko moggallo nāma, eko uggo nāma, eko nāvindakī nāma, eko gandhabbo nāma, eko aggivesso nāma.

examples.text: ime'pi rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakā bālā, yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.
sabbaphāliphullā kho, ānanda, yamakasālā akālapupphehi. te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.

53779.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu, te'pi evam'āhaṃsu, mayam'etaṃ jānāma, mayam'etaṃ passāma. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?

53785.commentary: (SaDM) yamu uparame. uparamo viramanaṃ. yamabhi. yamo. pare ca na vijānanti, mayam'ettha yamāmase'ti idam'ettha nidassanaṃ. tattha yamāmase'ti uparamāma, nassāma, marāmā'ti attho.

examples.text: pare ca na vijānanti, mayam'ettha yamāmase, ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā.

53786.commentary: (APt) yamaṃ saṃyamaṃ dadāti paresan'ti yamado ca so dakkhiṇeyy'aggittā aggi ce'ti yamadaggi, rāmassa pitā.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhako, vāmako, vāmadevo, vessāmitto, yamadaggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu

53788.meaning1: death's minion; death's messenger; death's worker; death's man
53788.commentary: (DHPa) yamapurisā'ti yamadūtā vuccanti, idaṃ pana maraṇam'eva sandhāya vuttaṃ, maraṇaṃ te paccupaṭṭhitan'ti attho.

examples.text: paṇḍupalāso'va dāni'si, yamapurisā'pi ca te upaṭṭhitā, uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

53790.meaning1: world of the dead; Yama's world

examples.text: nirayaṃ tiracchānayoniṃ, yamalokaṃ upapajjare, sace enti manussattaṃ, dalidde jāyare kule.
ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.

53791.meaning1: whatever I; which I; that I

examples.text: sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto vihareyyan'ti. upādiyamāno kho, bhikkhu, baddho mārassa, anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato'ti.
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.

53792.meaning1: as they say; which they said; which they called

examples.text: sātaṃ asātan'ti yam'āhu loke, tam'ūpanissāya pahoti chando, rūpesu disvā vibhavaṃ bhavañ'ca, vinicchayaṃ kubbati jantu loke.
na v'āham'etaṃ tathiyan'ti brūmi, yam'āhu bālā mithu aññam'aññaṃ, sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhim'akaṃsu saccaṃ, tasmā hi bālo'ti paraṃ dahanti.
tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho, micchāpaṭipadā.

tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca dukkhavipākaṃ, taṃ avidvā avijjāgato yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, idaṃ kho dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca dukkhavipākan'ti.
yam'idha pathaviñ'ca vehāsaṃ, rūpagatañ'ca jagat'ogadhaṃ, kiñci parijīyati sabbam'aniccaṃ, evaṃ samecca caranti mut'attā.
522, 476. isu yamūnam'anto ccho vā.
isu yamu'icc'etesaṃ dhātūnaṃ anto ccho hoti vā. icchati, niyacchati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? esati, niyamati.

53796.meaning1: name of a river; one of the five great rivers of ancient India

examples.text: kadā nu gaṅgaṃ yamunaṃ sarassatiṃ, pātālakhittaṃ vaḷavāmukhañ'ca, asajjamāno patareyyam'iddhiyā, vibhiṃsanaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyath'idaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti

53797.commentary: (DNa) gaṅg'odakaṃ yamun'odakenā'ti gaṅgāyamunānaṃ samāgamaṭṭhāne udakaṃ vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi saṃsandati sameti, majjhe bhinnasuvaṇṇaṃ viya ekasadisam'eva hoti, na mahāsamudda-udakena saṃsaṭṭhakāle viya visadisaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gaṅg'odakaṃ yamun'odakena saṃsandati sameti, evam'eva supaññattā tena bhagavatā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā, saṃsandati nibbānañ'ca paṭipadā ca.

53798.meaning1: whatever this means; concerning this matter

examples.text: sātaṃ asātañ'ca kutonidānā, kismiṃ asante na bhavanti h'ete, vibhavaṃ bhavañ'c'āpi yam'etam'atthaṃ, etaṃ me pabrūhi yatonidānaṃ.
vinicchayā yāni pakappitāni, te ve munī brūsi anuggahāya, ajjhattasantī'ti yam'etam'atthaṃ, kathaṃ nu dhīrehi paveditaṃ taṃ.
yam'etaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, ajita taṃ vadāmi te, yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, viññāṇassa nirodhena, etth'etaṃ uparujjhati.

ehi tvaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi, therā taṃ, āvuso khemaka, evam'āhaṃsu, yam'etaṃ, āvuso khemaka, asmī'ti vadesi, kim'etaṃ asmī'ti vadesi?
